name: uni 1.4.1 — Mac Calendar Sync Hotfix & Real-Time Date Advancement
body:
Fixes and improvements in uni v1.4.1:
• Resolved Mac Calendar Sync: Added ad-hoc code signature with dedicated calendar entitlements to allow macOS (Sonoma & Sequoia) full access to all system calendars (iCloud, Google, Exchange)
• Real-Time Automatic Date Updates: Dashboard and calendar views now advance to the new day automatically at midnight and upon waking from sleep without requiring an app restart
• Dynamic Event Store Reset: Instantly discovers and loads Mac system calendars upon authorization and system calendar changes
